cards.card_arrival: A new or replacement card has not arrived yet, or the customer wants to track its delivery
cards.activate_my_card: The customer has received a card and wants to activate it
cards.lost_or_stolen_card: The customer's card is lost, missing or stolen
cards.compromised_card: Someone else may be using the card or it shows transactions the customer did not make
cards.card_swallowed: An ATM or cash machine kept or took the card
cards.pin_blocked: The card PIN is blocked after failed attempts and must be unblocked
cards.card_not_working: The card fails for unexplained reasons across payments
cards.contactless_not_working: Contactless or tap payments specifically stopped working

transfers.transfer_into_account: Moving money into this account from another bank account
transfers.cancel_transfer: Stopping or reversing a transfer the customer already sent
transfers.failed_transfer: The app reports that an outgoing transfer failed
transfers.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is still shown as pending
transfers.transfer_timing: How long transfers normally take to arrive
transfers.transfer_fee_charged: The customer was charged a fee for making a transfer
transfers.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer to a specific beneficiary or recipient is not permitted
transfers.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The recipient says a completed transfer never reached them

account.passcode_forgotten: The customer forgot the app password or passcode
account.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details
account.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone with the banking app is lost or stolen
account.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required at all
account.age_limit: Minimum age requirements for opening an account
